/*							casinhl
 *
 *	Complex inverse hyperbolic sine
 *
 *
 *
 * SYNOPSIS:
 *
 * long double complex casinhf();
 * long double complex z, w;
 *
 * w = casinhl (z);
 *
 *
 *
 * DESCRIPTION:
 *
 * casinh z = -i casin iz .
 *
 * ACCURACY:
 *
 *                      Relative error:
 * arithmetic   domain     # trials      peak         rms
 *    IEEE      -10,+10     30000       1.8e-14     2.6e-15
 *
 */

#include <complex.h>
#include "math.h"

long double complex
casinhl(long double complex z)
{
	long double complex w;

	w = -1.0L * I * casinl(z * I);
	return (w);
}
